subject: Adaptive bundle and pilot offer for BeaconCare
messages:
From: Patricia Moore <patricia@beaconcare.com>
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-01T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Packaging & pilot — exploring a short Dedicated pilot + bundled features

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team loved the latency profile. We're running into a seasonal spike in Q3 and want to evaluate two things quickly: (1) a 90-day Dedicated pilot to validate throughput under production workload and (2) an adaptive bundle that includes the routing cache + priority SLA + model variant fallbacks. Procurement asked for an estimated cost and a proposal we can review this week so we can include it in our August vendor slate.

Attached is our short RFP and a usage snapshot. Questions from procurement: are there preferred commit tiers for the pilot? Any standard discount for a 12-month follow-on contract if the pilot is successful? Also need SOC2 evidence and SLA language for legal.

Can you send a short MAP and a ballpark commercial so I can circulate?

Thanks,
Patricia
VP Product Operations
BeaconCare

Attachments: RFP-BeaconCare-Q3.pdf (pdf, 1 page summary)

From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: Patricia Moore <patricia@beaconcare.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Packaging & pilot — exploring a short Dedicated pilot + bundled features

Patricia — great to hear, appreciate the RFP. High level proposal below; I can put formal MAP & quote in DocuSign once we align: 

- 90-day Dedicated pilot (NVIDIA H100 equivalent, autoscaling to 8 concurrent inference workers) — $12k flat pilot fee to cover reserved capacity and SRE support during pilot.
- Adaptive bundle (applies if you convert to committed 12 months): includes routing cache, priority SLA (99.9 latency targets), model variant fallback, and priority onboarding — proposed list price $12k/mo at the compact tier.
- Commercial: 18% off list for a 12-month commit following pilot + first 30 days of production waived if converted within 14 days of pilot end.

Next steps: draft MAP that lists success criteria (99th percentile latency target, throughput baseline, test dataset), pilot timeline, and deliverables (SRE onboarding session, SOC2 checklist). If that sounds reasonable I’ll loop in legal and propose a DocuSign.

—Ben
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

P.S. I attached a one-page offer summary and will share the MAP draft tomorrow.

Attachments: BeaconCare-offer-summary.xlsx (xlsx)

Quick sync — BeaconCare wants a 90-day Dedicated pilot and a strong conversion discount. My suggested commercial: 18% off for 12-month convert, pilot fee $12k, and first 30 days waived. They also want routing cache + priority SLA + model fallback included in bundle (no extra). Procurement wants SOC2 evidence & SLA redlines.

Requesting: 
- Approval to offer up to 20% discount if needed to close by 8/12 (we may need to escalate for >18%).
- Confirmation we can include the priority SLA language in our standard SOW (I _think_ yes but legal must sign off).
- Option idea: offer a one-time onboarding credit (50% of pilot fee) if they sign a 12-month commitment to sweeten conversion.

I’m drafting the MAP (attaching). I’ll aim to send external by EOD.

—Ben

From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-03T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: BeaconCare concession ask — pricing and pilot structure

Ben —
Thanks for the quick note. Approve up to 15% discount without exec sign-off. For 18%–20% we need a brief approval ticket from revenue ops and finance; escalate to me and I’ll route. I agree the onboarding credit is a good lever to preserve margin — try offering 50% of pilot fee back as a usage credit on conversion rather than a straight cash concession.

Require: legal to confirm SLA language and SOC2 evidence linkage before we finalize. Ask Patricia for a list of specific SLA redline items and set a hard stop of 8/12 for conversion approval to keep the quarter clean.

Share the MAP externally & include a short success criteria checklist (latency, top-5 API endpoints, 95th/99th targets).

—Lauren
VP Revenue Operations

From: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
To: Patricia Moore <patricia@beaconcare.com>, procurement@beaconcare.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, priyom_das@redwoodinference.com, sara.legal@beaconcare.com
Date: 2026-08-04T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: 90-day Dedicated pilot + conversion offer (summary)

Hi Patricia — attaching a short MAP and the offer summary for procurement/legal. Summary below: 

Pilot (90 days):
- Dedicated pilot environment with SRE support and onboarding (flat pilot fee $12,000).
- Success criteria: 99th percentile latency under X ms for identified endpoints; throughput >= 6k requests/min for canonical dataset; error rate < 0.1%.

Conversion commercial (if convert within 14 days of pilot end):
- 12-month contract at compact tier with Adaptive Bundle included (routing cache, model fallback, priority SLA).
- Commercial: 18% off list for a 12-month commit.
- Credit: 50% of pilot fee applied as usage credit on first invoice when converted.

Notes: 
- We can stretch to 20% only with approvals; 15% is within standard delegation.
- Legal: attached standard SLA excerpt and SOC2 evidence link; happy to take specific redlines.

DocuSign link to provisional MAP/quote: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/EXAMPLE-DS-12345
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/BEACON-2026-08

If this looks good I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff next week to align on test dataset and SRE contacts.

Thanks — Ben

Attachments: BeaconCare-MAP-draft.docx, BeaconCare-offer-summary.xlsx

From: Patricia Moore <patricia@beaconcare.com>
To: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@beaconcare.com, Sara Legal <sara.legal@beaconcare.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: 90-day Dedicated pilot + conversion offer (summary)

Ben — thanks, this is helpful and close to what procurement expected. A few items before we sign: 
1) Can you confirm the exact endpoints you’ll test for the 99th percentile target? We’ll push back if the list is broader than our production footprint.
2) Legal will redline the SLA; expect one small change around data retention on logs.
3) Procurement approves the pilot fee and the 18% conversion discount in principle — they'll route final sign-off after legal clears SOC2/SLA.

If legal is comfortable and we get a clarified endpoint list, we can commit to kickoff the pilot week of 8/17. Please include an itemized feature bundle in the MAP and I’ll route the DocuSign.

Best,
Patricia
VP Product Operations
BeaconCare
